نكتدح (form VIII)
# نَكْتَدِحُ (naktadiḥu) /nak.ta.di.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَدَحَ (iktadaḥa)
# نَكْتَدِحَ (naktadiḥa) /nak.ta.di.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَدَحَ (iktadaḥa)
# نَكْتَدِحْ (naktadiḥ) /nak.ta.diħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِكْتَدَحَ (iktadaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
